NOTIFICATION
No. 1772 of 2022/RR/NG Dated: 01.11.2022.
It is for the information of all those candidates who were declared
successful in the ·driving test held for the post of Driver-11 in the High Court of
Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, that their interview which was scheduled to be
held on 12.11.2022 and 19.11.2022 at High Court Complex Jammu/Srinagar,
respectively, pursuant to Notification No. 1547. of 2022/RR/NG dated
21.10.2022, is hereby postponed till further orders.
By order.
